System under review: an open-source multi-asset trading research platform.
It emits daily picks across CRYPTO, EQUITY, ETF, FOREX, COMMODITY, FUTURES, BOND,
MEMECOIN and PENNY_STOCK, using roughly 361 registered strategies grouped into 14
families (momentum, volatility, sentiment, trend, structure, volume, mean-reversion,
on-chain, community, carry, regime, macro, earnings, commodity-seasonal).
It also runs copy-trader mirroring, ML predictors, an evolution engine, and several
dashboards. Picks are stored in MySQL and rendered on a public audit dashboard with
Active Picks and Closed Picks tabs. There is an outcome resolver that assigns exit
prices and a profit factor / win rate per asset class. The operator wants to know
which asset class, if any, is worth risking real money on.

MEASURED EVIDENCE (live payload 2026-11-14T22:34Z, verified marks only):

TOTAL    6968         3350              48.1%          3618

"A forged flat" is a closed row whose exit_price equals entry_price, or pnl_pct is
exactly zero - the resolver wrote TIME_EXIT without marking to market. Spot checks
against real closes: V stamped 383.90 vs actual 425.76 (-9.83%); GOOGL 342.00 vs
295.77 (+15.63%); LLY 1189.41 vs 1443.50 (-17.60%).

Independent 2026-11-14 review of the same system: 0 of 23 profitability hypotheses
survived clean-OOS, effective-N, capital and execution gates; information coefficient
approximately zero (Pearson 0.039, Spearman 0.105); all 9 classes return
sizing_allowed=false. With 361 strategies tested, about 18 are expected to look
significant at alpha=0.05 purely by chance.

Costs: retail round-trip 2-5 bps ETF, 5-10 bps equity, 10-20 bps FX, 15-30 bps crypto.
Mutual funds settle once daily at next NAV and cannot host intrabar stops.
